# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1, reaching around fifty-five or fifty-six by Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and farm owner at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman constructed of sharp angles without curves, her dark hair showing streaks of gray and tightly twisted behind her head with two wire hairpins stuck aggressively through it. She has a mouth that, if slightly developed, might indicate a sense of humor. Over time, her face softens and her hair becomes grayer, though her rigid physical posture remains largely unchanged.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c33 P18](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0018)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience and rigid conscience, possessing an exacting, orderly nature that values neatness and duty above all else. Though outwardly stern, sarcastic, and unaccustomed to expressing affection, she harbors a deep, quiet tenderness and a dry sense of humor. She is firmly resolute in her decisions once made, yet possesses a practical fairness that allows her to admit her own mistakes. Over the years, her upbringing of Anne softens her rigid outlook and renders her much more mellow and tolerant.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c14 P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070)_

## Traits

- Strict and disciplined  <sub>[v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 c7 P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013)</sub>
- Extremely neat and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Reluctant to show emotion  <sub>[v1 c25 P59](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0059), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)</sub>
- Resolute and stubborn  <sub>[v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional housekeeping and cooking  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)</sub>
- Making famous homemade currant wine  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>

## Goals

- To properly train and educate Anne Shirley into a useful and moral woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- To maintain Green Gables and fulfill her duties toward her family  <sub>[v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, solitary life at Green Gables with her shy brother Matthew. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to assist Matthew on the farm, they were mistakenly sent an eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley. Though initially determined to return her, Marilla yielded to Matthew's wishes and agreed to raise the girl. Over the following years, Marilla conscientiously undertook Anne's upbringing, striving to correct her impulsive daydreams while gradually coming to love her as her own flesh and blood. When Matthew died suddenly of a heart attack following a bank failure, Marilla faced the prospect of selling Green Gables due to failing health and threatened blindness. However, Anne sacrificed her college scholarship to remain in Avonlea to teach and care for Marilla. To make the arrangement sustainable, Marilla invited her newly widowed friend, Rachel Lynde, to move into Green Gables, allowing Anne to pursue her college degree at Redmond while Marilla remained supported at home.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Quotes

> I’ve never brought up a child, especially a girl, and I dare say I’ll make a terrible mess of it. But I’ll do my best. So far as I’m concerned, Matthew, she may stay.  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

> If you’ll be a good girl you’ll always be happy, Anne. And you should never find it hard to say your prayers.  <sub>[v1 c10 P51](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0051)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you’ve been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
